description: Stop watching one job for good. Its check and incident history are deleted, and its ping_url answers 404 at once. It cannot be restored: heartbeat_add makes a new check with a new ping_url. It frees a job slot and works after the plan ended too. Returns deleted: true; an unknown or already removed heartbeat_id answers heartbeat_not_found. To pause alerts and keep the ping_url, use heartbeat_update.

heartbeat_id.description: heartbeat id (hbc_...) from heartbeat_add or heartbeat_status.

instance_id.description: Utility instance id from buy or list_utilities.

passport_token.description: Your amp_ token, only if you have no app sign-in and cannot send a header.

name: heartbeat_remove
title: Stop watching a job
